title: Resource Pack Freedom
description: A mod for Fabric and Neoforge that allows Server provided Resource packs be moved in the load order or removed entirely
body:
Gives you the freedom to arrange your resource packs however you like!

Resource packs provided by servers are always pinned to the top of you load order preventing you from overriding any of the textures. Well, no longer! Resource Pack Freedom removes ordering rescrictions on all resource packs allwoing you to place it wherever you wish or even remove it entirely.

### Planned Features
- Blocking Packs from downloading
- Hiding warnings for old and 'broken' packs
- Adding config options to allow features to be enabled/disabled
